notes.title: Global Update #0.4.2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31837594/c54d13964429de7b35618d22530eca1090fad975.jpg[/img]
- Improved the player's kick system from the server
- Removed the "free camera"
- Fixed radio station
- Fixed weapons cost
- Fixed friendly fire on vehicles
- Added light tanks: Pz2, BT-7
- Combat unit list calculation increased
- Added medical cars, tents for the class "Medic"
- Added cars for the commanders of company
- Fixed recoil for all weapons
- Fixed the scatter of some weapons (submachine guns)
- Fixed a damage detection (hit)
- Fixed shooting on client
- Optimization, increase FPS
- Added a new map with the mode "Capture the flag"
- Added the index of your transport
- Fixed transport, only the owner can get behind the wheel
